description: Predict the questions most likely to come up for one of the user’s target roles, with answer outlines drawn from their resume. Generation takes about 30–90 seconds; the record is saved only when it succeeds. Uses 1 prediction credit on success (PRO is not charged; nothing is charged on failure). If it is still running when this call returns, check list_question_predictions a little later: a new record means it finished; no new record after a few minutes means it failed and nothing was charged. Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)

experience.description: Experience level: Entry-level / 1-3 years / 3-5 years / 5-10 years / 10+ years

lang.description: Output language name, e.g. English, Simplified Chinese; defaults to the user interface language

resumeId.description: Resume ID from list_resumes; omit to base it on the role only
